description: exp025 - apples-to-apples FastMHL backbone control. EXACT clone of exp024's config/architecture with ONE change: backbone LUT module type HyperplaneMultiHeadLUT -> FastMultiHeadLut (fixed balanced anchor-pair sign tests, no learnable hyperplane projection). Same single-stream E=384 backbone, 6L/6h x d_qk=d_v=64/ctx512/vocab32768/RoPE1e4/untied tok_emb, LayerNorm pre-norms, plain nn.Linear(384->32768,bias=False) unembedder, LUT qk nap4/tph256 v nap6/tph256 out_proj nap7/tph512 (hard), seed 42, 16000 steps, 24576 tok/step (bs24 x seq512 x ga2), warmup1600 cosine 0.1x floor, Lion lut_lr 2e-4 tables / AdamW adam_lr 3e-4 (Linear unembedder wd0.1; tok_emb/norms wd0; the AdamW no-wd hyperplane group is EMPTY for FastMHL - expected), grad clip 1.0, eval every 200. FastMHL drops all hyperplane_weight/bias params (T*nap*(E+1) per site). Controls: exp023 learnable random-init 1.2063, exp024 learnable anchor-init 1.2034, exp010 dual-stream champion 1.1940. NOTE: exp024's 'fast' branch had a latent bug passing backward_mode= to FastMultiHeadLut (no such kwarg); removed in this exp025 train.py.
